name: google-maps/autocomplete
description: Get Google Maps search box suggestions for a partial query near a location, with place names, addresses and place IDs.

q.description: Parameter defines the search query. A query that would be used to provide completion options.

cp.description: Cursor pointer defines the position of cursor for the query provided, position starts from 0 which is a case where cursor is placed before the query `|query`. If not provided acts as cursor is placed in the end of query `query|`.

gl.description: Parameter defines the country to use for the Google Maps Autocomplete search. It's a two-letter country code. (e.g., `us` for the United States, `uk` for United Kingdom, or `fr` for France) Head to the Google countries page for a full list of supported Google countries.

hl.description: Parameter defines the language to use for the Google Maps Autocomplete search. It's a two or three-letter language code. (e.g., `en` for English, `es` for Spanish, or `fr` for French), optionally followed by a two-letter or three-digit region code (e.g., `en-gb` for British English, or `es-419` for Latin American Spanish). Head to the Google languages page for a full list of supported Google languages.

ll.description: Parameter defines the GPS coordinates of the location where you want the search to originate from. Its value must match the following format: `@` + `latitude` + `,` + `longitude` + `,` + `zoom/map_height` This will form a string that looks like this: e.g. `@40.7455096,-74.0083012,14z` or `@43.8521864,11.2168835,10410m`. The `zoom` attribute ranges from `3z`, map completely zoomed out - to `21z`, map completely zoomed in. Alternatively, you can specify `map_height` in meters (e.g., `10410m`).

json_restrictor.description: Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

# Google Maps Autocomplete

Get Google Maps search box suggestions for a partial query near a location, with place names, addresses and place IDs.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/google-maps/autocomplete" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"q": "coffee", "ll": "@30.2672,-97.7431,14z"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data` as structured JSON.

| `hl` | string | No | Parameter defines the language to use for the Google Maps Autocomplete search. It's a two or three-letter language code. (e.g., `en` for English, `es` for Spanish, or `fr` for French), optionally followed by a two-letter or three-digit regi |
| `cp` | string | No | Cursor pointer defines the position of cursor for the query provided, position starts from 0 which is a case where cursor is placed before the query `/query`. If not provided acts as cursor is placed in the end of query `query/`. |
| `json_restrictor` | string | No | Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details. |

## Pricing

$0.010 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged.
